entries.raw_rss_summary: In Kyiv's Solomianskyi district, a fire broke out in a five-story residential building after drone debris fell onto it. Two people were injured.

entries.original_title: Hungary greenlights opening of EU accession negotiation clusters 2 and 3 – Sybiha
entries.raw_rss_summary: Hungary has given the green light to opening negotiation clusters 2 and 3 on Ukraine's accession to the European Union.

entries.original_title: MFA currently sees no threat to Ukraine from possible plague outbreak in Russia
entries.raw_rss_summary: There is currently no threat to Ukraine from the possible emergence of plague in Russia.

entries.original_title: Russian strike on apartment building in Pryluky: Death toll rises to 16, 55 injured
entries.raw_rss_summary: The death toll from a Russian missile attack on Pryluky, Chernihiv region, on October 7 has risen to 16, including four children.

entries.original_title: EU ambassadors approve largest-ever sanctions list against Russia - source
entries.raw_rss_summary: Today, at a meeting of EU member states' representatives in the COREPER II format, ambassadors approved the largest-ever sanctions package against the aggressor state.

entries.original_title: Russians attack paper mill in Obukhiv, fires break out
entries.raw_rss_summary: Russian invaders launched a missile strike on the production and warehouse facilities of a paper mill in Obukhiv, Kyiv region, on October 7, sparking fires.

entries.original_title: Erdogan, Putin discuss navigation safety in Black Sea
entries.raw_rss_summary: Turkey stresses the importance of ensuring navigation safety in the Black Sea and is always ready to support efforts aimed at establishing direct contacts between Russia and Ukraine.

entries.original_title: Chentsov on new EU enlargement strategy: Ukraine needs clear perspective
entries.raw_rss_summary: Ukraine welcomes the European Commission's intention to adapt the European Union's enlargement policy to new realities and calls for agreement on a timeframe and political horizon for completing accession negotiations.

entries.original_title: Ukrainian strikes damage 14 oil storage tanks in Russia's Samara region – General Staff
entries.raw_rss_summary: Ukraine's General Staff has confirmed that 11 RVS-20000 oil storage tanks and three RVSPK-50000 tanks at the Samara linear production and dispatch station in Russia were damaged in strikes on October 2.

entries.original_title: Russian missile attack on Pryluky: Death toll rises to 14, 50 injured
entries.raw_rss_summary: The death toll from the Russian missile attack on Pryluky, Chernihiv region, on October 7 has risen to 14, including four children.

entries.original_title: Defense Forces strike Seshcha airfield in Russia's Bryansk region
entries.raw_rss_summary: Units of the Ukrainian Defense Forces struck the “Seshcha” airfield in the Bryansk region of the Russian Federation.

entries.original_title: Drone debris damages five houses in Zhmerynka
entries.raw_rss_summary: In Zhmerynka, Vinnytsia region, five homes were damaged by debris from downed drones.

entries.original_title: Media reports: Volgograd oil refinery halts operations following drone attack
entries.raw_rss_summary: The Volgograd Oil Refinery in Russia has completely halted oil refining after equipment was damaged in a drone attack on October 2.

entries.original_title: NATO Military Committee delegation in Kyiv: Russia will not succeed in undermining support for Ukraine
entries.raw_rss_summary: A delegation from the NATO Military Committee, led by its chairman, Admiral Giuseppe Cavo Dragone, visited Kyiv for talks with the leadership of the General Staff of the Armed Forces regarding the situation on the battlefield and continued support for Ukraine.

entries.original_title: Death toll in Oleksandriia rises to two
entries.raw_rss_summary: In Oleksandriya, Kirovohrad region, the death toll from Russian shelling has risen to two.

entries.original_title: Three children's bodies recovered from Pryluky rubble as death toll rises to nine, with 38 injured
entries.raw_rss_summary: In Pryluky, Chernihiv region, the death toll from the Russian strike has risen to nine; the bodies of three children were recovered from the rubble.

entries.original_title: Ukrainian forces hit two oil facilities, training range in Russia – Zelensky
entries.raw_rss_summary: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky has said that Ukraine's Defense Forces struck four targets that help Russia finance and wage its war, including two oil facilities and a training range in three Russian regions.

entries.original_title: Zelensky on Russian attack: Infrastructure in Kyiv and 12 regions hit, energy sector key target
entries.raw_rss_summary: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky has said that during the latest air attack, Russian forces used 70 missiles, many of them ballistic ones, as well as Shahed drones, with energy infrastructure being a key target. Infrastructure in Kyiv and 12 regions came under attack.

entries.original_title: Death toll from Russian missile strike on Pryluky rises to five, 25 injured
entries.raw_rss_summary: The death toll from a Russian strike on an apartment building in Pryluky, Chernihiv region, has risen to five.

entries.original_title: Dovzhenko Film Studio in Kyiv damaged again in Russian attack
entries.raw_rss_summary: The building of the Oleksandr Dovzhenko National Film Studio in Kyiv was damaged in a Russian attack early on October 7.

entries.original_title: Russian missile strike on Pryluky kills four, injures 20
entries.raw_rss_summary: The death toll from a Russian strike on an apartment building in Pryluky, Chernihiv region, has risen to four.

entries.original_title: Russian missile attack on Kremenchuk kills two, injures seven
entries.raw_rss_summary: Two people were killed and seven others injured in a Russian attack on Kremenchuk, Poltava region, according to preliminary reports.

entries.original_title: Unexploded ballistic missile being neutralized in Kyiv's Darnytskyi district
entries.raw_rss_summary: Police and the State Emergency Service are carrying out a complex operation to neutralize an unexploded ballistic missile found among residential buildings in Kyiv's Darnytskyi district.

entries.original_title: Massive attack: Air defenses neutralize 117 drones, five ballistic missiles, 39 cruise missiles
entries.raw_rss_summary: Ukraine's air defense forces neutralized five ballistic missiles, 39 cruise missiles and 117 drones used by Russian forces to attack Ukraine since the evening of October 6.

entries.original_title: Russian missile hits apartment block in Pryluky, casualties reported
entries.raw_rss_summary: A Russian strike damaged an apartment block in Pryluky, Chernihiv region, killing and injuring civilians.

entries.original_title: Russian forces attack critical infrastructure in Oleksandriia, killing one and injuring three
entries.raw_rss_summary: Russian invaders attacked critical infrastructure in Oleksandriia, Kirovohrad region, on the morning of October 7, leaving people injured.

entries.original_title: War update: 202 clashes on front line over past day
entries.raw_rss_summary: On October 6, 202 clashes between the Ukrainian Defense Forces and Russian invaders were recorded along the front.

entries.original_title: Russia loses another 1,690 troops in war against Ukraine over past day
entries.raw_rss_summary: The total combat losses of Russian forces since the beginning of the full-scale invasion of Ukraine, from February 24, 2022, to October 7, 2026, amount to approximately 1,545,950 personnel, including 1,690 over the past day.
